[[File:Artoo_lights_up_B2s.jpg|thumb|right|250px|R2-D2 ignites an oil slick to incinerate two super battle droids]]
The '''oil slick''' was a simple and effective utility item that enabled a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to produce a thin film of oil across the path of the enemy. This resulted in slowing the forward progress of an enemy and allowed allies to retreat or attack using ranged weapons.

==History==
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], near the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] was captured by two [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] aboard [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]. To elude capture, he released his oil slick, causing the battle droids to lose their footing. The [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] then activated his [[Rocket booster/Legends|rocket boosters]], igniting the oil and incinerating his captors.
